designContract.principle: A documentary figure adds information, not another decorative card. Maintain story chronology and existing TOC/anchors/source-return; no duplicate timeline/matrix, no second component engine.
designContract.desktop: Story-column intrinsic widths; preserve original image ratio. Use paired exhibits only where both have purpose and enough legible width; not across unrelated sections.
designContract.mobile: Stack all pairs when story width insufficient; no carousel or hover dependency, no horizontal overflow at 320. Never crop text on posters; use intrinsic dimensions and caption below.
designContract.print: If approved, keep figure and caption together when physically feasible; do not force entire chapter into one page. Check actual A4/Letter PDFs in light/dark and JS/noJS; maintain source links, no empty placeholders.
designContract.accessibility: Native figure/figcaption, meaningful visible content alt and text captions, keyboard source return, unique citation ID after Research adoption. No external image requests in public route until rights and hosting confirmed.
designContract.release: No new publicly visible source, claim, image, CSS, routing or data changes. Existing approved content remains unchanged. If rights unresolved, omit figure entirely, not a visible HOLD placeholder. New links require editorial/source gate.

prototype.delivery: Owner chat only; standalone text-only review composition with six chapters, no imported source media or external auto-requests. No fake document artwork.

qa.critique: Typography hierarchy and stacked mobile layout coherent for internal planning. Repeated document rules and large sequence of text-only modules would be monotonous if literally copied into article; use 3–5 high-value actual figures and omit the rest. Fallback font Georgia, not canonical Astro typography.

limitations: Review-only artifact. No full actual route build or actual A4/Letter PDF, no integration, no images downloaded, no license, no external outreach. The paired 2019/2020 sample is comparison only: production placements stay in individual year blocks. 10 slots are possibilities, not ten additions. Do not count as released visual material.
